clips.title: The story
paras: Peons work under Foreman Thazz'ril in the Valley of Trials. The orc labor supervisor keeps crews on schedule and supplies ready for young warriors, but slacking workers and nearby cultists frustrate him.

In the Valley of Trials, Foreman Thazz'ril directs peons who chop lumber and gather materials for the encampment and young warriors. Building a home in Durotar's harsh red rock takes steady labor, yet the peons often nap under the desert sun. Thazz'ril sends newly arrived recruits to rouse the sleepers with his blackjack, and keep construction moving.

While scouting the Burning Blade Coven for mineral resources, Thazz'ril fled the dark cultists inside and accidentally left his treasured enchanted pick behind. Warlocks and their demonic minions now gather in the cave. Too cautious to retrieve the tool himself, Thazz'ril relies on young Horde aspirants to venture into the depths and bring it back.
